I farm by what I have seen work here, not by fancy talk. I have 16.1 mu, and with just 2 people in the house, I will not spread myself too thin. I will keep most land in the wheat-maize round because that is the steady way for me, and I will leave a smaller piece for cotton. I start from what I did before: wheat and maize get the better land and the better fertilizer because grain is what keeps the year safe. I have well water, so I will use it when the crop really needs it and not wait for the sky. On fertilizer, I would rather spend a bit more than come up short and watch the field turn weak. Around here, if wheat base fertilizer is too light, the stand is thin; if maize topdressing is too little, the ears stay small. So I will put enough on, close to what the better neighbors do, and I will keep tillage simple with rotary work because my area is not tiny but not so big that I can waste money turning the land too deep everywhere.
